'''John Legrasse''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Unvisited Isle]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Will]]

You can claim [[monster]]s with the [[Endless]] ability as [[trophy|trophies]].

[[Category:Allies]]

==Mythos Source==

Inspector John Raymond Legrasse, a New Orleans police inspector, appears in Lovecraft's ''The Call of Cthulhu'' (1926), one of the core stories of the Mythos.  Legrasse's story of a raid on a cult ceremony, "The Tale of Inspector Legrasse", makes up the second phase of that story.
